nodes.label: Principle 7: sentence length 30-45 chars
nodes.rationale: 30-45 char range is the skill's operating guideline, not a number from the cited paper.

nodes.label: Idempotent scripts (set -euo pipefail)
nodes.rationale: Scripts check for existing files before linking so re-runs never overwrite existing configuration.

nodes.label: What ADHD changes about reading
nodes.rationale: Small working memory, knowing vs doing gap, starting is hardest, uniform time sense, scarce dopamine drive every rule.

nodes.label: Documents go through show-me with text visuals
nodes.norm_label: documents go through show-me with text visuals
nodes.rationale: Visuals are text only because HTML cannot live in a PR body or Markdown file.

nodes.label: pstack takes precedence over CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: pstack skills defer to CLAUDE.md by default; this setup wants the reverse on three points: final reply, PR/commit text, and whether to ask.

nodes.label: Session id from ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json
nodes.rationale: herdr's tracked session id can be overwritten by a subagent session (autoharness reflector), so the id is read from the claude process's own file.

nodes.norm_label: dropped skills (review-pr, guide, empirical-prompt-tuning, find-skills, autopilot, asuforce-mode, create-pr, apply-review, create-repo)
nodes.rationale: Replaced by built-ins (code-review, plan mode, claude plugin eval, /plugin) or pstack (opening-a-pr, poteto-mode), or unused.

nodes.label: graphify (graphifyy via mise)
nodes.rationale: Installed via mise as a PyPI package, reinstalled by runtime.sh each run; install redirected to a temp CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so it does not append to the linked ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; placed in runtime.sh because make all runs llm before runtime.

nodes.label: graphify hook-guard PreToolUse hooks
nodes.rationale: Registered in user settings; only acts when graphify-out/graph.json exists; invoked as bare graphify to go through mise shim.

nodes.label: i-have-adhd skill (ayghri/i-have-adhd)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in per session (disable-model-invocation kept); conflicts with closing-heading rule and lets the harness win.

nodes.label: Current skill roster
nodes.rationale: before-compact, claude-restart, design-renewal, design-score-loop, grill-me, grill-with-docs, plus vendored show-me, yomiyasu, i-have-adhd.

nodes.label: yomiyasu skill (nanaism/yomiyasu)
nodes.rationale: Rewrites AI-generated Japanese into natural prose; vendored from skills/yomiyasu/; dropped .claude-plugin and logo asset.

nodes.label: Fail-open hooks (llm/hooks/)
nodes.rationale: Each SessionStart/PreToolUse hook does nothing when it cannot decide rather than erroring.

nodes.label: Skills only, no commands
nodes.rationale: Skills carry a description the model can reach for unprompted; keeping commands too meant two mechanisms for one job. Skills are dropped once a built-in covers them.

nodes.label: Text visuals (pseudocode, call tree, file tree, Mermaid, diff)
nodes.norm_label: text visuals (pseudocode, call tree, file tree, mermaid, diff)

nodes.label: Pick the smallest view that makes the point
nodes.norm_label: pick the smallest view that makes the point

nodes.label: Linux package list (Brewfile counterpart)
nodes.rationale: AUR not used; packages omarchy already ships are left out; gh comes from mise.

nodes.label: Codex does the coding under pstack (codex:codex-rescue)
nodes.norm_label: codex does the coding under pstack (codex:codex-rescue)
nodes.rationale: Main chat keeps planning, verification, judgment and prose; coding roles go to Codex.

nodes.label: Codex model/effort per task class
nodes.rationale: gpt-6.1-sol low by default, gpt-6-luna for mechanical edits, high only after a failed verification, for cost.

nodes.label: Codex result is a claim; verify and --resume
nodes.norm_label: codex result is a claim; verify and --resume

nodes.label: before-compact skill
nodes.rationale: Compaction drops detail, so durable facts are saved to memory before /compact; a skill cannot run /compact itself.

nodes.label: Update existing memory instead of duplicating
nodes.norm_label: update existing memory instead of duplicating

nodes.label: Brewfile
nodes.rationale: Ruby evaluated by brew bundle so entries can be gated with if personal; keeps one tracked alphabetical list serving machines with and without self-managed applications; run without --cleanup so gated-off entries are skipped not uninstalled.

nodes.label: omarchy (Arch Linux) target
nodes.rationale: Makefile and scripts branch on uname -s; omarchy owns packages, login shell and several configs, so each path is replaced by the repo's file or left alone per app; ~/.ssh/config is kept as config.omarchy.bak.

nodes.label: Symlink-based dotfiles architecture
nodes.rationale: config/ is the source of truth; scripts/link.sh creates symlinks into place.

nodes.label: make home-server
nodes.rationale: Hosts mf-dashboard Docker Compose stack without staying awake all day; not part of make all so a machine never opts itself in.

nodes.label: Make targets (all, link, brew, pkg, macos, llm, runtime, xcode)
nodes.norm_label: make targets (all, link, brew, pkg, macos, llm, runtime, xcode)
nodes.rationale: On Linux make all runs pkg -> link -> llm -> runtime and skips macOS-only targets.

nodes.label: Night suspend / 05:55 RTC wake schedule
nodes.rationale: Suspends from 22:00 when locked (22:30 regardless), wakes 05:55 and restarts crawler because supercronic's timer does not advance during suspend; crawl at 06:00.

nodes.label: config/packages/linux.txt
nodes.rationale: Linux counterpart of the Brewfile; fed to omarchy pkg add by scripts/pkg.sh; AUR not used, HackGen fetched upstream.

nodes.label: ~/.config/dotfiles/personal marker
nodes.rationale: Marker presence is the only discriminator by design; hardcoded under $HOME because brew bundle scrubs XDG_CONFIG_HOME; make personal is kept out of make all so a machine never opts itself in.

nodes.label: llm/pstack-priority.md
nodes.rationale: pstack skills defer to CLAUDE.md by default; this rule reverses that for closing headings, PR/commit text, and whether to ask.

nodes.label: Copied (not symlinked) configs
nodes.rationale: .gitconfig, .gitconfig-work, SSH config and ~/.zshrc.work are copied to allow local modification.

nodes.label: Cleanup pass (promote to ADR, absorb into CONTEXT.md, delete)
nodes.norm_label: cleanup pass (promote to adr, absorb into context.md, delete)

nodes.label: CONTEXT.md
nodes.rationale: CONTEXT.md is a glossary only, devoid of implementation details; created lazily when the first term is resolved.

nodes.label: PoC Decision Log Format
nodes.rationale: Differs from ADR only in confidence; allowed to be wrong, append on reversal rather than delete.

nodes.label: Ask questions one at a time
nodes.norm_label: ask questions one at a time

nodes.label: When to offer an ADR (hard to reverse, surprising, real trade-off, survived PoC)
nodes.norm_label: when to offer an adr (hard to reverse, surprising, real trade-off, survived poc)

nodes.label: No index file
nodes.rationale: An index becomes a merge-conflict magnet across PRs; ls is enough.

nodes.label: Where decisions get recorded
nodes.rationale: Many projects keep no file-based decision record; follow an existing convention or ask once, never scaffold docs/adr or docs/poc speculatively.

nodes.label: Frontier-based question rounds
nodes.rationale: Batch every decision whose prerequisites are settled into one round; defer questions depending on unresolved ones in the same round.

nodes.label: Ghostty
nodes.rationale: Terminal herdr runs on; herdr vendors Ghostty's VT engine and depends on the kitty keyboard protocol and kitty graphics virtual placeholders, both implemented by Ghostty.

nodes.label: herdr (terminal multiplexer)
nodes.rationale: Owns panes, tabs, workspaces and copy mode; holds the prefix ctrl+g so the terminal must not bind pane/tab keys that would shadow it.

nodes.label: env plugin
nodes.rationale: Secrets entered in a pane Claude cannot read so tokens never enter the transcript.

nodes.label: pstack plugin (cursor/plugins)
nodes.rationale: poteto-mode routes work to playbooks; runs only when invoked or matched by the autoharness pstack-poteto-mode-routing skill.

nodes.label: config/herdr/config.toml
nodes.rationale: Hand-written entries limited to deviations from herdr --default-config so upgrades do not become full-file diffs; herdr also writes machine keys via its UI.

nodes.label: llm/plugins.tsv
nodes.rationale: Plugins installed rather than vendored because they ship hooks, MCP servers or backends a skill-only copy would not run; optional OS column limits rows.

nodes.label: Delegation through pstack
nodes.rationale: Delegation goes through pstack; herdr is used only when asked for.

nodes.label: llm/pstack-codex.md
nodes.rationale: Routes coding roles to codex:codex-rescue and pins Codex model/effort per task class for cost.

nodes.label: Adjustment round
nodes.rationale: Adjective-only requests get one question for a reference URL or scene; scenes resolve in one round.

nodes.label: Reference round
nodes.rationale: Code stays untouched until the user picks traits; screenshots give no px or hex so computed styles are read.

nodes.label: Short commands (preview, commit, advisor review, polish)
nodes.norm_label: short commands (preview, commit, advisor review, polish)

nodes.label: Awwwards scoring sheet
nodes.rationale: Design 40/usability 30/creativity 20/content 10; content is scored but not edited to avoid padding copy.

nodes.label: Codex model and effort by task
nodes.norm_label: codex model and effort by task

nodes.label: Claude plugin installation
nodes.rationale: Plugins ship hooks, MCP servers or backends that a skill-only copy would not run.

nodes.label: Codex delegation brief
nodes.rationale: Codex does not read pstack skills, so each brief specifies the goal, scope, completion check and relevant constraints.

nodes.label: Codex configuration setup
nodes.rationale: Existing configuration is preserved while missing settings and MCP definitions are added.

nodes.label: show-me visual skill
nodes.rationale: The local copy remains model-invocable so document rules can trigger it unprompted.

nodes.label: Vendored skills and upstream review
nodes.rationale: Upstream changes to prompts require review before application.

nodes.label: Document visual requirement
nodes.rationale: PR descriptions and technical documents use show-me with a text visual carrying the main point.

nodes.label: Shared graphify artifacts
nodes.rationale: Committed graph outputs and semantic cache allow other machines to reuse the graph and update only changed documents.

nodes.label: Graphify installation and hooks
nodes.rationale: Runtime setup installs the graphify package and skill while avoiding writes through the linked global CLAUDE.md.
